title.zh: 新泽西州官员就预测市场向美国最高法院提出请愿
title.en: New Jersey officials petition US Supreme Court over prediction markets

current_state.zh: 美国最高法院相关案件收到多方反对联邦监管预测市场的意见书；新泽西请求最高法院裁决州与联邦管辖权之争，案件朝最终裁决推进。
current_state.en: The U.S. Supreme Court case has received multiple briefs opposing federal oversight of prediction markets; New Jersey has asked the Supreme Court to resolve the state-versus-federal jurisdiction dispute as the case moves toward a definitive ruling.

updates.title_zh: 新泽西州官员就预测市场向美国最高法院提出请愿
updates.title_en: New Jersey officials petition US Supreme Court over prediction markets
updates.what_changed_zh: 新泽西州官员向美国最高法院提出请愿，要求裁定州政府还是联邦当局对 Kalshi 等预测市场平台拥有管辖权。
updates.what_changed_en: New Jersey officials petitioned the US Supreme Court to determine whether state or federal authorities have jurisdiction over prediction market platforms like Kalshi.
updates.current_state_zh: 新泽西州官员向美国最高法院提出请愿，要求裁定州政府还是联邦当局对 Kalshi 等预测市场平台拥有管辖权。
updates.current_state_en: New Jersey officials petitioned the US Supreme Court to determine whether state or federal authorities have jurisdiction over prediction market platforms like Kalshi.

updates.title_zh: NFL加入反对预测市场的行列，美国最高法院被要求采取行动
updates.title_en: NFL joins pushback against prediction markets as U.S. Supreme Court asked to act
updates.what_changed_zh: NFL、州政府、Gary Gensler 和前参议员 Chris Dodd 等方向美国最高法院提交法庭之友意见书，反对CFTC对预测市场的专属监管，支持州级博彩监管权。
updates.what_changed_en: The NFL, state governments, Gary Gensler and former Senator Chris Dodd filed Supreme Court amicus briefs opposing exclusive CFTC oversight of prediction markets and supporting state gambling regulators.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国最高法院相关案件收到多方反对联邦监管预测市场的意见书；新泽西请求最高法院裁决州与联邦管辖权之争，案件朝最终裁决推进。
updates.current_state_en: The U.S. Supreme Court case has received multiple briefs opposing federal oversight of prediction markets; New Jersey has asked the Supreme Court to resolve the state-versus-federal jurisdiction dispute as the case moves toward a definitive ruling.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The NFL, state governments, Gary Gensler and former Senator Chris Dodd filed Supreme Court briefs opposing federal oversight of prediction markets such as Kalshi and Polymarket, as the case moves toward a definitive ruling.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The NFL, state governments, Gary Gensler and former Senator Chris Dodd filed Supreme Court briefs opposing federal oversight of prediction markets such as Kalshi and Polymarket, as the case moves toward a definitive ruling.
